clusters_added.jtbd: Developer who pays for an AI code-review tool (e.g. CodeRabbit) wants unthrottled, affordable automated review of AI-agent-generated PRs

evidence.quote: I got an annual subscription to Code Rabbit but now they are throttling reviews to only 2 per hours! What are you guys using for code review? Obviously Codex/Claude GitHub connectors are not doing a good job and paying per use for Code Rabbit is rediculous expensive.

clusters_added.kill_reason: Only one independent signal class found (HN Ask HN); no corroborating freelance gig, app-store gap, or second community source. Competitive set (CodeRabbit, GitHub Copilot code review, Greptile, Qodo) is entrenched/well-funded -- high risk even if a second signal appears.
